key_insight: HERO is a pathology foundation model designed to preserve strong histology representations while being more robust to hospital, scanner, and stain variation.
clinical_relevance: If validated further, this could improve the reliability of computational pathology tools when they are deployed across different clinical sites and imaging conditions.
method: ViT-G/14 pathology encoder trained with DINO and iBOT self-supervision
Trained on a morphology-balanced corpus of 500 million tiles from ~575,000 clinical whole-slide images
evidence_signal: In the abstract, HERO is reported to lead on robustness across center, scanner, and stain shifts, rank first on average across 39 slide-level clinical tasks, and perform comparably on tile-level classification, segmentation, and gene-expression prediction.
watch_item: The results are benchmark-based, so real-world deployment still needs external validation across diverse clinical workflows and prospective settings.
paper_title: HERO: Histology Encoder for Robust Representation in Oncology
